name: figma
purpose: Files, frames and comments in Figma

apiKey.name: X-Figma-Token
apiKey.help: Figma → Settings → Security → Personal access tokens

guide:
The Figma REST API (https://www.figma.com/developers/api), as the person.

```sh
curl -s https://api.figma.com/v1/me
curl -s 'https://api.figma.com/v1/files/FILE_KEY?depth=2'
curl -s 'https://api.figma.com/v1/images/FILE_KEY?ids=NODE_ID&format=png'
curl -s https://api.figma.com/v1/files/FILE_KEY/comments
```

A comment asks the person first unless they allowed changes.
